opti-1: A highway cuts across the Everglades.
opti-2: Day and night, cars speed across it.
opti-3: But panthers need to cross to find food and mates.
opti-4: So engineers built wide tunnels under the road.
opti-5: Hidden cameras help check if the design works.
opti-6: If you were an engineer hired to fix one of Florida's habitat problems, what would you build, and how would you know if it worked?
31-02-welcome: Our film starts on a highway that cuts right through panther country. First, inspect a mystery branch.
31-02-lesson: Today you're an engineer. Watch the design process, run the Tunnel Test, then visit four real Florida fixes.
31-02-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
31-02-assign: Time to show what you learned. Pick a challenge, then sketch and label your own design.
how-31-02-specimen: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the branch, then tap three things you notice.
how-31-02-compare: Put the panther at one crossing and the turtle at the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Send them through. Then swap.
how-31-02-wall: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-31-02-det: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap the fact that is a constraint, a limit, then name what the design must do. Predict how it turned out, and see the evidence.
how-31-02-partc: Draw your design for the challenge you picked in Part B. Label at least 5 parts: the threat, your solution, at least one native plant or animal that benefits, and two more parts of your design.
